# Uniqlo Price Tracker

> A free, daily-updated price tracking tool for Uniqlo Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Japan.

## What it does

- Tracks prices across Uniqlo products in each supported country, updated once per day
- Shows recorded prices below their typical tracked price, with discount percentages based on that history
- Flags **Lowest recorded** prices — the cheapest observed since tracking began
- Displays full **price history charts** for individual products
- Organises products by Uniqlo category (e.g. T-Shirts, Jeans, Outerwear, Knitwear, etc.)
- Covers Women's, Men's, Kids' and Baby lines

## Who it's for

Shoppers in supported countries who want to know when Uniqlo products go on sale or reach their lowest price observed by the tracker, without checking the Uniqlo website manually every day.

## Key facts

- Regions: /ca (CAD), /us (USD), /uk (GBP), /jp (JPY); Canada is the default. Prices are not currency conversions.
- Update frequency: Once per day
- Free to use — no account or sign-up required
- Not affiliated with Uniqlo Co., Ltd.

## URL

https://www.uniqlotracker.com
